pages.cento: IN ÆSTV TEMPERIES, IN FLETV SOLATIVM.

lines.la: Irrigat, & fotos gremio, mox tollit in altos
lines.en: He waters them, and those cherished in his bosom he soon raises to the lofty

loci.virgil: inrigat, et fotum gremio dea tollit in altos

lines.la: Cælicolúm lucos, vbi mollis amaracus illos
lines.en: groves of the heaven-dwellers, where soft marjoram them

loci.virgil: Idaliae lucos, ubi mollis amaracus illum

lines.la: Floribus, & dulci aspirans complectiturvmbra.
lines.en: with flowers, and, breathing, embraces with sweet shade.

loci.virgil: floribus et dulci adspirans complectitur umbra.

lines.la: IN ÆSTV TEMPERIES, IN FLETV SOLATIVM.
lines.en: IN HEAT, RELIEF; IN WEEPING, SOLACE.

lines.la: Cumq́ue ager exustus morientibus æstuat herbis,
lines.en: And when the scorched field swelters with dying grasses,

loci.virgil: et, cum exustus ager morientibus aestuat herbis,

lines.la: Tunc propiore Dei iam afflato Numine, flamen
lines.en: Then, with the nearer divine power of God now breathed forth, the breeze

lines.la: Diuinum. Zephyris astrorum temperat ignes.
lines.en: divine. With Zephyrs it tempers the fires of the stars.

lines.la: Inque suo fletu, magnum est solamen amanti.
lines.en: And in his weeping, it is a great solace to the lover.

lines.la: O LVX BEATISSIMA, REPLE CORDIS INTIMA TVORVM FIDELIVM.
lines.en: O MOST BLESSED LIGHT, FILL THE INMOST HEARTS OF YOUR FAITHFUL.

lines.la: O lux alta polo, terris bis terque beata,
lines.en: O light high in heaven, twice and thrice blessed on earth,

lines.la: Insidas animi medicatis sedibus, hospes,
lines.en: may you settle as a guest in the healed dwellings of the soul,

lines.la: Intima te in nostræ condens præcordia mentis.
lines.en: hiding yourself in the inmost depths of our mind.

lines.la: SINE TVO NVMINE NIHIL EST IN HOMINE.
lines.en: WITHOUT YOUR DIVINE POWER THERE IS NOTHING IN MAN.

lines.la: Quid mortale, precor, genus est, te Numine læso?
lines.en: What, I pray, is the mortal race, if your Godhead is offended?

lines.la: Sontibus in cassum nomen tribuetur amicum,
lines.en: In vain will a friendly name be granted to the guilty,

lines.la: Libera ni vitio, sua subdere colla Tonantis
lines.en: unless, free from vice, to submit their necks to the Thunderer's

lines.la: Imperio assuerint, Christique facessere iussa.
lines.en: command they accustom themselves, and to execute the orders of Christ.

lines.la: LAVA QVOD EST SORDIDVM.
lines.en: WASH WHAT IS FILTHY.

lines.la: Ergo age, fœdatas lethali crimine mentes,
lines.en: Come then, the minds defiled by deadly sin,

lines.la: Aspergens rosea pretiosi sanguinis vnda,
lines.en: sprinkling with the rosy wave of precious blood,

lines.la: Ablue, sedata iam factus mitior ira.
lines.en: wash clean, having now become milder with anger calmed.

lines.la: RIGA QVOD EST ARIDVM.
lines.en: WATER WHAT IS DRY.

lines.la: Arida cùm noceant, stet corda rigare voluntas,
lines.en: Since dry things do harm, let the will stand firm to water the hearts,

lines.la: Auster ab optato pluuias inducat Olympo.
lines.en: let the South wind bring rains from the longed-for Olympus.

lines.la: SANA QVOD EST SAVCIVM,
lines.en: HEAL WHAT IS WOUNDED,

lines.la: FLECTE QVOD EST RIGIDVM,
lines.en: BEND WHAT IS RIGID,

lines.la: FOVE QVOD EST FRIGIDVM.
lines.en: WARM WHAT IS COLD.

lines.la: Saucia Pœoniis medicina potentibus herbis
lines.en: Wounded, medicine with potent Paeonian herbs,

lines.la: Vulnera da instauret, mihi nec medicetur Iápis.
lines.en: grant that it may restore the wounds, and let not Iapis heal me.

lines.la: Non mihi tam prudens quisquam persuadeat auctor,
lines.en: Let no advisor, however wise, persuade me

loci.virgil: Nec tibi tam prudens quisquam persuadeat auctor

lines.la: Tellurem, Borea rigidam spirante, mouere,
lines.en: to move the earth when Boreas blows it stiff,

loci.virgil: tellurem Borea rigidam spirante movere.

lines.la: Rura gelu dum claudit hyems, nec semine iacto
lines.en: while winter shuts the fields with frost, and, when the seed is cast,

loci.virgil: Rura gelu tum claudit hiems nec semine iacto

lines.la: Concretam patitur radicem figere terræ:
lines.en: does not allow the frozen root to fix itself to the earth:

loci.virgil: concretam patitur radicem adfigere terrae.

lines.la: Cùm rigefacta volens robustus iugera fossor
lines.en: When the sturdy digger, wishing the stiffened acres

loci.virgil: et labefacta movens robustus iugera fossor.

lines.la: Vertere, quidquid agar, frustra, nil proficit instans:
lines.en: to turn, whatever I may do, in vain, pressing on he accomplishes nothing:

lines.la: Tu verò Omnipotens solo potes omnia nutu.
lines.en: But you, Almighty, can do all things by your nod alone.

lines.la: Flecte quod est rigidum, gelidis licet insonet alis
lines.en: Bend what is rigid, even if there sounds with icy wings

lines.la: Vnà Eurusque Notusque ruens creberque procellis
lines.en: Eurus and Notus rushing together, and, thick with storms,

loci.virgil: una Eurusque Notusque ruunt creberque procellis

lines.la: Africus, & vastos voluant ad littora fluctus.
lines.en: Africus, and they roll vast waves to the shores.

loci.virgil: Africus, et vastos volvunt ad litora fluctus.

lines.la: Frigida corda foue. cælesti ardore calescant.
lines.en: Warm cold hearts. Let them grow warm with heavenly heat.

lines.la: REGE QVOD EST DEVIVM.
lines.en: GUIDE WHAT IS ASTRAY.

lines.la: Auia quosque sequi cursu, discrimine magno,
lines.en: And those whom to follow pathless ways in their course, at great peril,

lines.la: Cernis, aberrantes, nota regione viarum,
lines.en: you see, wandering, from the known region of the roads,

lines.la: In tutum reduces versis Aquilonibus actos,
lines.en: brought back to safety, driven by the turned North winds,

lines.la: Da videam, ac duce te, vento gaudere secundo.
lines.en: grant that I may see, and, with you as guide, rejoice in a favorable wind.

lines.la: DA TVIS FIDELIBVS,
lines.en: GIVE TO YOUR FAITHFUL,

lines.la: IN TE CONFIDENTIBVS,
lines.en: WHO TRUST IN YOU,

lines.la: SACRVM SEPTENARIVM.
lines.en: THE SACRED SEVENFOLD GIFT.

lines.la: Pectora fida tuæ fidei quæ castra sequuntur,
lines.en: The faithful hearts that follow the camp of your faith

lines.la: Æternique Dei supremum Numen adorant.
lines.en: and adore the supreme Godhead of the eternal God.

lines.la: Muneris, alme, tui, septeno robore firma.
lines.en: strengthen, O kind one, with the sevenfold vigor of your gift.

lines.la: DA VIRTVTIS MERITVM,
lines.en: GIVE THE REWARD OF VIRTUE,

lines.la: DA SALVTIS EXITVM,
lines.en: GIVE THE OUTCOME OF SALVATION,

lines.la: DA PERENNE GAVDIVM.
lines.en: GIVE EVERLASTING JOY.

lines.la: Da sua cultori quos virtus spondet honores,
lines.en: Grant to the worshipper the honors which his own virtue promises,

lines.la: Decursumque diem felici claudere fato,
lines.en: and to close the completed day with a happy fate,

lines.la: Lætaque lassatæ succedere tempora menti,
lines.en: and for glad times to follow for the wearied mind,

lines.la: Vt simul æternum, ter Io, ac Pæana canamus.
lines.en: so that together we may sing forever 'Io!' thrice, and the paean.

lines.la: Hymnus, SALVE REGINA.
lines.en: Hymn, SALVE REGINA.

lines.la: Salue quæ Diuûm incedis Regina, simulq́ue
lines.en: Hail, you who walk as Queen of the Heavenly Ones, and at once

lines.la: Nata parensq́ue Dei, tot partis aucta triumphis,
lines.en: daughter and mother of God, enriched by so many triumphs won,

lines.la: Summa parens summæ pietatis, vita, salusque,
lines.en: supreme mother of supreme mercy, our life, and salvation,

lines.la: Hyblæum decus, & generis fiducia nostri,
lines.en: Hyblaean glory, and the trust of our race,

lines.la: Te Superûm imperiis iterum saluere iubebo.
lines.en: at the commands of the Heavenly Ones I shall bid you hail once more.

lines.la: Nos patriæ fines, ac dulcia liquimus arua,
lines.en: We have left the borders of our fatherland, and our sweet fields,

loci.virgil: nos patriae fines et dulcia linquimus arva:

lines.la: Erramus fatis acti maria omnia circum;
lines.en: we wander, driven by the fates, around all the seas;

loci.virgil: errabant, acti fatis, maria omnia circum.

lines.la: Exilioque domos, alio sub sole iacentes,
lines.en: and homes in exile, lying beneath another sun,

lines.la: Quærimus, heu profugi, atque Euæ miseranda pro pago.
lines.en: we seek, alas, as fugitives, and the pitiable offspring of Eve.

lines.la: O sola infandos hominum miserata labores,
lines.en: O you who alone have pitied the unspeakable toils of men,

loci.virgil: O sola infandos Troiae miserata labores,

lines.la: Haud ignara mali, miseris succurrere docta,
lines.en: not unacquainted with misfortune, taught to succour the wretched,

loci.virgil: Non ignara mali, miseris succurrere disco."

lines.la: Quæ nos relliquias Adæ, terraque marique.
lines.en: who us, the remnants of Adam, both on land and sea,

lines.la: Omnibus exhaustos iam casibus, omnium egenos,
lines.en: now exhausted by all misfortunes, destitute of all things,

loci.virgil: omnibus exhaustos iam casibus, omnium egenos,

lines.la: Vrbe, domo socias: miseri te in vota vocamus:
lines.en: you associate in city and home: in our misery we call upon you in our prayers:

loci.virgil: urbe, domo, socias, grates persolvere dignas

lines.la: Ad te Euæ soboles lacrymosa hac valle laborum
lines.en: to you the offspring of Eve, in this tearful vale of toils,

lines.la: Suspirans, imoque trahens à pectore vocem,
lines.en: sighing, and drawing its voice from the depths of its breast,

loci.virgil: suspirans, imoque trahens a pectore vocem:

lines.la: Stat lacrymans, valido gemitu tua Numina poscens.
lines.en: stands weeping, beseeching your divine power with strong groaning.

lines.la: Alma ergo Genitrix, qua non præstantior vlla
lines.en: Therefore, kindly Mother, than whom none is more excellent

lines.la: Ore ciere Deum, ac summum exorare Parentem,
lines.en: at calling upon God with her voice, and prevailing upon the supreme Father,

lines.la: Huc geminas nunc flecte acies pietatis auitæ,
lines.en: turn hither now your two eyes of ancestral mercy,

loci.virgil: "Huc geminas nunc flecte acies, hanc aspice gentem

lines.la: Clementisque animi Genitricis lumina in istam
lines.en: and the eyes of a merciful mind and of a Mother upon this

lines.la: Christiadum gentem conuerte, vt cernere Iesum
lines.en: race of Christians turn, so that to behold Jesus

lines.la: Post miserum hoc vitæ exilium, tellure reposta,
lines.en: after this wretched exile of life, with the earth laid aside,

lines.la: Felicesque vteri valeat decerpere fœtus.
lines.en: and may be able to gather the blessed fruit of your womb.

lines.la: O clemens, ò corde pia, ô dulcedine vincens
lines.en: O clement, O loving of heart, O you who surpass in sweetness

lines.la: Suauia mella, decus, specimen niueique pudoris,
lines.en: sweet honey, glory and pattern of snow-white chastity,

lines.la: Magna parens Superûm, nostri haud meminisse graueris,
lines.en: great Mother of the Heavenly Ones, do not be loath to remember us,

lines.la: Quò tua gens magnum cæli ventura sub axem,
lines.en: so that your people, destined to come beneath the great vault of heaven,

loci.virgil: progenies magnum caeli ventura sub axem.

lines.la: Promissis Christi longum fruitura per æuum,
lines.en: to enjoy the promises of Christ through the long ages,

lines.la: Gestiat, æternas soluens pro munere grates.
lines.en: may exult, rendering eternal thanks for the gift.

lines.la: QVEM TERRA, PONTVS, ÆTHERA, &c.
lines.en: WHOM EARTH, SEA, SKY, &c.

lines.la: Qui mare, qui terras, qui cælum Numine complet,
lines.en: He who fills the sea, who fills the lands, who fills the heaven with his Godhead,

loci.virgil: qui mare, qui terras omni dicione tenerent,

lines.la: Quique opus hoc triplex ingenti mole superbum
lines.en: And who this threefold work, proud in its vast mass,

lines.la: Sustinet, immensæ valido molimine dextræ:
lines.en: Sustains, by the mighty effort of his immense right hand:

lines.la: Quemque suis nequeunt spaciis comprendere cæli,
lines.en: And whom the heavens cannot contain within their spaces,

lines.la: Hunc humiles habitare casas, vterique latebras
lines.en: Him to inhabit humble cottages, and the hiding-places of the womb

lines.la: Iuuit adoptatas Mariæ, claustrique pudoris
lines.en: It pleased, the adopted ones of Mary, and of the cloister of modesty

lines.la: Intemerare fidem, castosque sacrare hymenæos.
lines.en: To keep unviolated the faith, and to consecrate chaste nuptials.

lines.la: Quique globum mundi, roseis Aurora quadrigis
lines.en: And He who the globe of the world, while Aurora in her rosy four-horse chariot

lines.la: Dum manè exoritur, Phœbæa lampade lustrat;
lines.en: While she rises in the morning, illuminates with Phoebus's lamp;

lines.la: Vespere at emenso, cùm iam ruit Oceano nox,
lines.en: But when evening is spent, when night now rushes from the Ocean,

loci.virgil: Hoc etiam, emenso cum iam decedit Olympo,
"Vertitur interea caelum et ruit oceano nox,

lines.la: Inuoluens vmbra magna terramque polumque,
lines.en: Enveloping both earth and sky in a great shadow,

loci.virgil: involvens umbra magna terramque polumque

lines.la: Lucentem Lunam, radiantiaque astra ministrat
lines.en: Supplies the shining Moon, and the radiant stars

lines.la: Quò remees tacitæ per amica silentia noctis;
lines.en: By which you may return through the friendly silences of the quiet night;

loci.virgil: a Tenedo tacitae per amica silentia lunae

lines.la: Mensibus ecce nouem, postquam spirabile Numen
lines.en: Behold, in nine months, after the breathing Godhead

lines.la: Numine complerat diuinæ viscera matris,
lines.en: Had filled the womb of the divine mother with His Godhead,

lines.la: Felici partu sub luminis editurcantas,
lines.en: By a happy birth he is brought forth into the shores of light,

lines.la: Mox infans vtero egrediens, mirantibus astris,
lines.en: Presently the infant emerging from the womb, while the stars marvel,

lines.la: Virginea fragrante rosa pulcherrimus exit.
lines.en: Comes forth most beautiful from the fragrant virgin rose.

lines.la: Felix ò nimiùm Genitrix, bis terque beata,
lines.en: O Mother too happy, twice and thrice blessed,

lines.la: Quæ tanto Superûm doni cumularis honore,
lines.en: Who are heaped with so great an honor of a gift of the Heavenly Ones,

lines.la: Vt quem non tenuit regio vastissima Olympi,
lines.en: That He whom the vastest region of Olympus did not contain,

lines.la: Deligat arctari, sacra vt se virgine condat.
lines.en: Should choose to be confined, that He may hide Himself in the sacred virgin.

lines.la: Felix Aligeri vocis celebrata canore,
lines.en: Happy, celebrated by the melody of the Winged One's voice,

lines.la: Qui fuit arcanos missus recludere fontes,
lines.en: Who was sent to unseal the hidden springs,

lines.la: Læta Dei partu, dum Numine Numen obumbrat,
lines.en: Joyful in the birth of God, while Godhead overshadows with Godhead,

lines.la: Delicias vtero effundens, spemque vbere lactans,
lines.en: Pouring forth delights from the womb, and nursing hope at the breast,

lines.la: Qua desiderij satiantur vota parentum:
lines.en: By which the vows of the forefathers' desire are satisfied:

lines.la: Das etenim Virgo, vt spes quod sperarat haberet.
lines.en: For you grant, O Virgin, that hope might have what it had hoped for.

lines.la: Laus tibi virgineæ satus es qui sanguine Diuæ
lines.en: Praise to You, who are sprung from the blood of the virgin Goddess,

lines.la: Cum Patre cælesti, ac diuina Numinis aura,
lines.en: With the heavenly Father, and the divine breath of the Godhead,

lines.la: Tergeminoque vnique Deo laus, æqua potestas,
lines.en: And to the threefold and one God be praise, equal power,

lines.la: Sit par imperium, cui metas tempora poni
lines.en: Let there be equal dominion, to which times that limits be set

lines.la: Posse negent, cùm sint æterni præmia regni?
lines.en: Deny to be possible, since they are the rewards of an eternal kingdom?

lines.la: AMEN.
lines.en: AMEN.

lines.la: AVE MARIS STELLA, &c.
lines.en: HAIL, STAR OF THE SEA, etc.

lines.la: Salue siderium pelagi decus, æthera lustrans,
lines.en: Hail, starry glory of the sea, traversing the heavens,

lines.la: Nata Patris summi, Genitrix simul alma parentis,
lines.en: Daughter of the highest Father, and at once nurturing Mother of your parent,

lines.la: Virginei splendor floris, niueique pudoris
lines.en: Splendor of the virginal flower, and of snow-white modesty

lines.la: Æternum specimen, quo non præstantius vllum
lines.en: The eternal pattern, than which none is more excellent,

lines.la: Felices reserans aditus bipatentis Olympi;
lines.en: Unlocking the happy approaches of double-gated Olympus;

lines.la: Dulce melos nunti, sacro Gabrielis ab ore,
lines.en: The sweet song of the messenger, from the sacred mouth of Gabriel,

lines.la: Digna referre polo. Sociali fædere pacis
lines.en: things worthy to be told back to heaven. With the allied covenant of peace

lines.la: Progeniem hanc firma; simul Euæ ignobile nomen
lines.en: Strengthen this offspring; and at the same time the ignoble name of Eve

lines.la: Da generis vestri radiorum luce coruscet.
lines.en: Grant that it may gleam with the light of the rays of your race.

lines.la: Huc illuc vinclorum immensa volumina versans,
lines.en: Turning hither and thither the immense coils of chains,

loci.virgil: huc illuc vinclorum immensa volumina versat.

lines.la: Ne dubita soluisse reos, commissa fatentes:
lines.en: Do not hesitate to have loosed the guilty, confessing their offenses:

lines.la: Pectora cæca tui circumda solis a mictu.
lines.en: Surround blind hearts with the mantle of your sun.

lines.la: Quo te cumque locus miserantem incommoda nostra
lines.en: Wherever a place, pitying our misfortunes, you

loci.virgil: Quo te cumque lacus miserantem incommoda nostra

lines.la: Orbe tenet, quocumque solo pulcherrima regnas,
lines.en: holds in the world, on whatever soil you reign most beautiful,

loci.virgil: fonte tenet, quocumque solo pulcherrimus exis,

lines.la: Semper honore meo, semper celebrabere votis;
lines.en: Always with my honor, always with my prayers will you be celebrated;

loci.virgil: semper honore meo, semper celebrabere donis

lines.la: Adsis ô tandem, & propiùs res aspice
lines.en: O be present at last, and look more closely upon things

loci.virgil: parce pio generi, et propius res aspice nostras.

lines.la: Fas tibi mortales Cocyti arcere periclis,
lines.en: It is lawful for you to ward off mortals from the perils of Cocytus,

lines.la: Ne pigeat miseris animi succurrere rebus.
lines.en: Let it not irk your mind to succor wretched affairs.

lines.la: Munera multa tuis poscens, ditabis egenos:
lines.en: Asking many gifts for your own, you will enrich the needy:

lines.la: Dulcia materni faueant mihi Numinis ora,
lines.en: May the sweet face of the maternal Deity favor me,

lines.la: Atque tuis faciles allabi vocibus aures
lines.en: And that compliant ears glide to your words

lines.la: Obtineas supplex; mihi nec malè Numen amicum
lines.en: May you obtain [this] as a suppliant; nor the Deity unfriendly to me

loci.virgil: Hic mihi nescio quod trepido male numen amicum

lines.la: Esse sinas, remouens animis cælestibus iras.
lines.en: allow to be, removing wrath from heavenly minds.

lines.la: Te Genitrice, memor sit se de virgine natum,
lines.en: With you as Mother, may he be mindful that he was born of a virgin,

lines.la: Subsidioque datum vitæ mortalibus ægris.
lines.en: and given as a support of life to sick mortals.

lines.la: O præstans virgo, generis fiducia nostri,
lines.en: O excellent Virgin, the confidence of our race,

lines.la: Insigni decorata animum pietatis honore,
lines.en: adorned in mind with the distinguished honor of piety,

lines.la: Nos omni scelerum polluta fæce solutos,
lines.en: Us, freed from all the polluted dregs of crimes,

lines.la: Egregio cultu mitis, cordisque pudici.
lines.en: gentle in outstanding devotion, and of chaste heart,

lines.la: Da, precor, ornari, duplicato Numinis æstu.
lines.en: Grant, I pray, to be adorned, with the redoubled ardor of the Deity.

lines.la: Eia age, diua parens, nostros, rogo, dirige gressus,
lines.en: Come now, divine Parent, I ask, direct our steps,

lines.la: Currere iter rectum fas sit liquido æquore classem:
lines.en: let it be lawful for the fleet to run a straight course on the clear sea:

lines.la: Ne paterè, amisso fluitantem errare Magistro,
lines.en: Do not suffer it to wander adrift, with its Master lost,

loci.virgil: cum pater amisso fluitantem errare magistro

lines.la: Matrisat auxiliis interrita cærula verrat,
lines.en: but by the Mother's help let it sweep the blue waters unafraid,

lines.la: Optato donec liceat consistere portu.
lines.en: Until it is permitted to rest in the longed-for harbour.

lines.la: Fas vbi sit lætis pia Numinis ora tueri,
lines.en: Where it may be lawful for the joyful to behold the holy face of the Deity,

lines.la: Et canere æternum dulci modulamine carmen
lines.en: And to sing an everlasting song with sweet melody:

lines.la: Laus tibi virgineo satus es qui sanguine. &c.
lines.en: Praise to you who are sprung from virgin blood. &c.

lines.la: O GLORIOSA DOMINA, &c.
lines.en: O GLORIOUS LADY, &c.

lines.la: O decus ætherium, superæ pars maxima gentis.
lines.en: O ethereal glory, greatest part of the heavenly race,

lines.la: Lumine multiplici Titania sidera vincens:
lines.en: Surpassing the Titanian stars with manifold light:

lines.la: Conditor omnipotens, qui te sub luminis auras
lines.en: The almighty Creator, who you into the breezes of light

lines.la: Edidit è nihilo, velut infans dulcia lambens,
lines.en: Brought forth out of nothing, like an infant licking sweet things,

lines.la: Ecce tuo suaui in gremio quondam vbera suxit.
lines.en: Behold, once sucked the breasts in your sweet lap.

lines.la: Quod tulit, infringens summi mandata Parentis,
lines.en: What she took away, breaking the commands of the highest Father,

lines.la: Eua suo generi (cui aecersit Numinis iras)
lines.en: Eve from her race (for whom she summoned the wrath of the Deity),

lines.la: Felici partu reddis mortalibus ægris
lines.en: you restore to sick mortals by a happy birth.

lines.la: Hinc fletu, & mœstis latè loca questibus olim
lines.en: Hence with weeping and sad laments far and wide the places once

loci.virgil: integrat et maestis late loca questibus implet.

lines.la: Qui luctu implebant, læti nunc munere diuûm,
lines.en: those who filled with grief, now glad through divine gift,

lines.la: Haudquaquam cessant ter Io, ter dicere Pæan.
lines.en: by no means cease to cry thrice 'Io!', thrice 'Paean!'

lines.la: Sicque tuæ, virgo, soboli fis ianua vitæ,
lines.en: And thus, Virgin, you become the gate of life to your offspring,

lines.la: Cùm per te cælos, portis bipatentibus, intrent.
lines.en: since through you they enter the heavens by the double-opening gates.

lines.la: Tu molles aditus Regis, tu commoda letho
lines.en: You the gentle approaches to the King, you the favourable times for death

lines.la: Tempora sollicitas natis, ter maxima cura
lines.en: solicit for your children, O thrice-greatest care.

lines.la: Ista tibi hinc portæ titulo fas, inde fenestræ
lines.en: Let it be right for you to be called those things, on this side by the title of gate, on that of window,

lines.la: Nomine, ius tibi sit, diuina sorte, vocari.
lines.en: By name, let it be your right, by divine lot, to be called.

lines.la: Plaudite felices animæ, quibus ista salutis
lines.en: Applaud, O happy souls, for whom this auspicious gate

lines.la: Ianua fausta patet. Mihi da quoque celsa recludi
lines.en: Of salvation opens. Grant to me also that the lofty halls

lines.la: Atria Cælicolûm, potis es namque omnia nutu,
lines.en: Of the heaven-dwellers be opened, for you are capable of all things by a nod,

lines.la: Ceu Patris æterni Genitrix, cui summa potestas.
lines.en: As the Mother of the eternal Father, who has supreme power.

lines.la: Laus tibi virgineo satus es qui sanguine matris,
lines.en: Praise to you who are sprung from the virgin blood of your mother,

lines.la: Cum Patre cælesti, ac diuina Numinis aura,
lines.en: With the heavenly Father, and the divine breath of the Deity,

lines.la: Ter geminoque vnique Deo laus, æqua potestas,
lines.en: And to the threefold and one God be praise, equal power,

lines.la: Sit par imperium, cui metas tempora poni
lines.en: Let there be equal dominion, to which the ages limits to be set

lines.la: Posse negent, cùm sint æterni præmia regni.
lines.en: they would deny it to be possible, since they are the rewards of the eternal kingdom.

lines.la: AMEN.
lines.en: AMEN.

lines.la: AVE REGINA CÆLORVM, &c.
lines.en: HAIL, QUEEN OF THE HEAVENS, etc.

lines.la: Salue celsa tenens cælestis sceptra coronæ,
lines.en: Hail, holding the lofty sceptres of the heavenly crown,

lines.la: Cœtibus Aligerûm iam tot dominata per annos,
lines.en: Having ruled over the assemblies of the Winged Ones for so many years now,

loci.virgil: Urbs antiqua ruit, multos dominata per annos;

lines.la: Ter sancta ô radix salue, qua desuper orbi
lines.en: O thrice-holy root, hail, by which from above to the world

lines.la: Aurea lux oritur, roseis aduectâ quadrigis,
lines.en: The golden light arises, conveyed by rosy chariots,

lines.la: Salue Christicolis, cælorum porta patescens:
lines.en: Hail, gate of the heavens opening for the worshippers of Christ:

lines.la: Gaude virginei decus immortale pudoris,
lines.en: Rejoice, immortal glory of virginal modesty,

lines.la: Eximium formæ specimen, radiantia vincens
lines.en: Outstanding model of beauty, surpassing the radiant

lines.la: Sidera, præ reliquis, multo splendore coruscans,
lines.en: Stars, gleaming with much splendour beyond the rest,

lines.la: Ter formosa vale, tensisque ad Numina palmis,
lines.en: Thrice-beautiful one, farewell, and with palms stretched out to the Godhead,

lines.la: Ne pigeat votis, nostram exorare salutem,
lines.en: May it not displease you to entreat our salvation with prayers,

lines.la: Dans precibus lætos supera nos sede potiri.
lines.en: Granting by your prayers that we joyfully obtain the heavenly seat.

lines.la: Ad Beatam Virginem Dei genitricem pro felici exitu ex hac vita.
lines.en: To the Blessed Virgin, Mother of God, for a happy departure from this life.

lines.la: Virgo potens animos hominum lenire dolentes,
lines.en: Virgin, powerful to soothe the grieving minds of men,

lines.la: Solando, ac dictis miserorum auertere curas;
lines.en: By consoling, and to turn away the cares of the wretched with words;

lines.la: Per summa illa tuum quæ cepit gaudia,
lines.en: By those highest joys which seized your [heart],

lines.la: Quando tuam sobolem rediuiuam ad sidera rursus
lines.en: When your offspring, living again, to the stars once more

loci.virgil: turbatis distractus equis, ad sidera rursus

lines.la: Ætherea, & superas cæli venisse sub auras,
lines.en: Ethereal, and to have come beneath the upper breezes of heaven,

loci.virgil: aetheria et superas caeli venisse sub auras,

lines.la: Est tibi sorte datum, deuicta morte, tueri;
lines.en: It was granted to you by lot to see, with death conquered;

lines.la: Obsecro ne dubiis animi succurrere rebus
lines.en: I beseech you, do not refuse to help the doubtful affairs of the soul

lines.la: Natorum renuas, Erebi quos cura remordet:
lines.en: Of your children, whom the anxiety of Erebus torments:

lines.la: Cernis vt ancipiti binas examine lances
lines.en: You see how, with a doubtful balance, the two scales

lines.la: Aliger æthereus ferat, & simulacra duarum
lines.en: The ethereal Winged One carries, and the images of two

lines.la: Hinc simul atque illinc animarum imposta ferantur,
lines.en: Souls placed upon them are carried, at once on this side and on that,

lines.la: Dissimili Indicio, vt pateat discrimine iusto,
lines.en: With a different sign, so that it may be revealed by a just distinction,

lines.la: Quam damnet scelus, & magno cum pondere ad Orcum
lines.en: Which one wickedness condemns, and with great weight to Orcus

lines.la: Deprimat, aut melior quam tollat ad æthera virtus.
lines.en: Presses down, or which one better virtue raises to the ether.

loci.virgil: Iuppiter, aut ardens evexit ad aethera virtus,

lines.la: Heu quibus Inferni non maximus ingruat horror,
lines.en: Alas, upon whom would the greatest horror of Hell not rush,

lines.la: Incertis quò fata vocent, vbi sistere detur?
lines.en: Uncertain where the fates may call, where it may be granted to stand?

loci.virgil: incerti, quo fata ferant, ubi sistere detur,

lines.la: Pro se quisque suam, manifesto crimine, caussam
lines.en: Each one for himself, with crime made manifest, his own cause

loci.virgil: pro se quisque viri, et depromunt tela pharetris.

lines.la: Solus aget, Superùm atque hominum spectante corona:
lines.en: Will plead alone, with the circle of those above and of men watching:

lines.la: Ipse autem Aligerûm in medio, cæloque volantûm,
lines.en: But He Himself in the midst of the Winged Ones, and of those flying in heaven,

printed_notes.text_en: On the scales of St Michael.

printed_notes.text: Incertitudo salutis reddit nos in omni vita perplexos.
printed_notes.text_en: Uncertainty of salvation leaves us perplexed all our life.

lines.la: Rex erit, & media stellarum luce, corusca
lines.en: He will be King, and amid the light of the stars, on a flashing

lines.la: Nube sedens, hominum vitas & crimina discet,
lines.en: cloud sitting, he will learn the lives and crimes of men,

lines.la: Quas non hîc latebras, quæ non & operta recludet,
lines.en: what hiding-places will he not lay open here, and what hidden things,

lines.la: Qui dat inaccessos animi penetrare recessus?
lines.en: he who grants to penetrate the inaccessible recesses of the mind?

lines.la: Nescius ah quoties falsa sub imagine veri,
lines.en: Ah, how often, unknowing, under a false image of the true,

lines.la: Spiramenta animæ lethali vulnere rupi?
lines.en: have I burst the breathing-passages of the soul with a deadly wound?

lines.la: An non sæpè intus, qui nos fugit, abditus error,
lines.en: Has not a hidden error within, which escapes our notice, often

lines.la: Infandum suasit cæli contra omina bellum,
lines.en: urged that an unspeakable war against the omens of heaven,

loci.virgil: Ilicet infandum cuncti contra omina bellum,

lines.la: Contra fata Deûm, peruerso Numine posci?
lines.en: against the decrees of God, be demanded by a perverse spirit?

loci.virgil: contra fata deum perverso numine poscunt,

lines.la: Fòrs data nequidquam diuinæ semina flammæ,
lines.en: Perhaps the seeds of divine flame, given in vain,

lines.la: Abstrusa in venis latuere, haud cordis in imo
lines.en: lay hidden, concealed in the veins, and did not, deep in the heart,

loci.virgil: abstrusa in venis silicis, pars densa ferarum

lines.la: Accensi viguere sinu, nilque æthere dignum,
lines.en: flourish kindled in its bosom, and nothing worthy of heaven

lines.la: Haudque sui memores alios fecere merendo.
lines.en: did they do, and did not make others mindful of them by deserving well.

loci.virgil: quique sui memores alios fecere merendo,

lines.la: Ah quoties etiam Lethæi ad fluminis vndam,
lines.en: Ah, how often too, at the wave of the Lethean river,

loci.virgil: corpora debentur, Lethaei ad fluminis undam

lines.la: Non bene securum laticem, ac obliuia potans,
lines.en: drinking a liquid not truly carefree, and forgetfulness,

lines.la: Arguar officij immemoris, quod iure piandum est!
lines.en: shall I be accused of forgotten duty, which must by right be expiated!

lines.la: Sicque Dei necdum antiquum saturata dolorem
lines.en: And so of God, not yet having sated its ancient grief,

loci.virgil: multa movens, necdum antiquum saturata dolorem.

lines.la: Ira, graui faciet pœna commissa luamus.
lines.en: the wrath will make us pay for our offenses with heavy punishment.

lines.la: Si pauidi tremuere metu (sua voluere fata
lines.en: If they trembled, fearful with dread (they willed their own fates,

lines.la: Nam Sancti affuerunt) hos si circumstetit horror,
lines.en: for the Saints were present), if horror stood around these,

lines.la: Quos sua pro meritis euexit ad æthera virtus;
lines.en: whom their own virtue raised to the heavens for their merits;

lines.la: Quid mirum est trepidare metu, quem crimina sontē
lines.en: what wonder is it that he trembles with fear, whom as guilty crimes

lines.la: Multa premunt? feriere miser, frangêre procella,
lines.en: many weigh down? You will be struck, wretch, you will be shattered by the storm,

lines.la: Fæx scelerum, te triste nefas, te triste manebit
lines.en: dregs of wickedness, a grim abomination will await you, a grim

lines.la: Supplicium, votisque Deum venerabere seris,
lines.en: punishment, and you will worship God with belated prayers,

lines.la: Ni pietatis opem exoret pia Virgo roganti,
lines.en: unless the holy Virgin win by entreaty the aid of mercy for the one asking,

lines.la: (Scilicet haud animo nequidquam exterrita mater,
lines.en: (the mother, surely, not terrified in spirit to no purpose,

lines.la: Atque animæ ingenti luctantis mota periclo)
lines.en: and moved by the great peril of the struggling soul)

lines.la: Huic nam parta quies, omnisque in limine portus,
lines.en: for rest is won for him, and the whole haven is at the threshold,

loci.virgil: Nam mihi parta quies, omnisque in limine portus;

lines.la: Stella maris tumidum precibus cui temperat æquor:
lines.en: for whom the Star of the Sea calms the swelling sea with her prayers:

lines.la: Funere felici numquam spoliabitur insons,
lines.en: the innocent man will never be robbed of a happy death,

lines.la: Cælesti Mariæ protectus pectora voto.
lines.en: his breast protected by the heavenly prayer of Mary.

lines.la: Ergo age, diua Parens Christi sanctissima, vates
lines.en: Come then, divine Parent of Christ, most holy, prophetess

lines.la: Præscia venturi (si non indebita posco
lines.en: foreknowing the future (if I ask for no undue

loci.virgil: praescia venturi, da, non indebita posco

lines.la: Regna meis fatis) cùm possis omnia nutu,
lines.en: realms to my fates), since you can do all things by a nod,

loci.virgil: regna meis fatis, Latio considere Teucros

lines.la: Gloria cælicolûm, da me considere Olympo,
lines.en: Glory of the heaven-dwellers, grant that I may settle on Olympus,

lines.la: Fas vbi sit Christo iungi, vultuque foueri,
lines.en: where it may be lawful to be joined to Christ, and cherished by His countenance,

lines.la: Expleri mentem vt nequeam, ardescamque tuendo,
lines.en: so that I cannot sate my mind, and may burn with gazing,

printed_notes.text_en: Cleanse me from my hidden faults, O Lord.
printed_notes.explanation: The biblical prayer identifies the surrounding lines with sins concealed even from the sinner.

printed_notes.text_en: Sins of ignorance.
printed_notes.explanation: This label classifies the first group of hidden faults.

printed_notes.text_en: Saul is a witness to this.
printed_notes.explanation: Saul/Paul’s persecution of Christians before his conversion exemplifies culpable action done in ignorance.

printed_notes.text: Quam pauci cum Apostolo dicere possunt: Gratia Dei in me vacua non fuit. 1 Corint. c. 15.
printed_notes.text_en: How few can say with the Apostle: The grace of God in me has not been void. 1 Corinthians, ch. 15.
printed_notes.explanation: The single continuous gloss introduces Paul’s claim as a difficult standard of grace made fruitful in works.

printed_notes.text_en: Sins of forgetfulness.
printed_notes.explanation: This label marks a second class of faults: duties forgotten.

printed_notes.text: Quam multis profuerit in hora mortis B. Virginis Mariæ auxilium.
printed_notes.text_en: How many the help of the Blessed Virgin Mary has profited at the hour of death.
printed_notes.explanation: The final label applies the nautical rescue imagery to Marian intercession at death.

lines.la: Complexu sobolis pendens, colloque parentis,
lines.en: Hanging in the embrace of the Offspring, and on the neck of the Parent,

lines.la: Dum magnum veri implero Genitoris amorem.
lines.en: While I fulfill the great love of the true Father.

lines.la: Errantes simul adde viros, attritaque corda,
lines.en: Add at the same time erring men, and contrite hearts,

lines.la: Qui reuocare gradum, superasque euadere ad auras
lines.en: Who to retrace their step, and to escape to the upper air

loci.virgil: sed revocare gradum superasque evadere ad auras,

lines.la: Ex animo cupiunt, diuũque insistere plantis.
lines.en: Desire from the heart, and to tread in the footsteps of the saints.

lines.la: Multa Dei ante aras nostra cadet hostia dextra,
lines.en: Many a victim will fall before the altars of God by our right hand,

loci.virgil: multa tibi ante aras nostra cadet hostia dextra."

lines.la: Ritè suum pariter matri dicemus honorem,
lines.en: Duly likewise we will declare her own honor to the Mother,

lines.la: Aligerum admisti lituis, fidibusque sonoris,
lines.en: Mingled with the clarions of the winged ones, and sounding lyres,

lines.la: Certantes dulci modulamine vincere Nymphas,
lines.en: Striving to surpass the Nymphs with sweet melody,

lines.la: Queis etiam cithara cogatur Thracius Orpheus
lines.en: To whom even Thracian Orpheus with his lyre would be compelled

lines.la: Cedere, cùm numeris septem discrimina vocum
lines.en: To yield, when to the rhythms the seven distinct notes

loci.virgil: obloquitur numeris septem discrimina vocum,

lines.la: Obloquitur, digitisue aut pectine pullat eburno.
lines.en: He sounds in accompaniment, or strikes them with his fingers or an ivory plectrum.

loci.virgil: iamque eadem digitis, iam pectine pulsat eburno.

lines.la: AMEN.
lines.en: AMEN.
